title: 015 高中物理精通获取016 难忘的夜晚
slug: 从小欢喜开启诸天之旅
content_zh:
天台上，马尾辫女孩独自哭泣。
陆泽来到这里的时候，看见的只有一个孤零零的背影。
这个一直在班里笑得大大咧咧没心没肺的女孩似乎是第一次哭的这么伤心。
他缓缓的走到同桌的身边，没有开口安慰，只是默默的掏出来一张湿纸巾。
乔英子拿着这张纸巾，忽然就哭的更加厉害起来。
“她为什么要那个样子对我啊？我的梦想是成为一名宇航员，不是高考考七百分。”
“那是她的梦想，不是我的！”
乔英子眼睛哭的红肿起来，心里十分不理解妈妈为什么就不能尊重她的想法。
从小到大她一直都是按照妈妈给她规划的路线在走，而只要当两個人产生一点点分歧的时候，英子最终似乎都是要转到妈妈的那个名叫‘为你好’的路线之上。
陆泽轻轻的拍了拍乔英子的头。
他的语气有些温柔。
“别哭啦，你现在照照镜子看看自己是不是很丑？你不是说以后还罩着我呢嘛，现在这个样子可一点都不像那么大姐大一样的乔英子啊。”
乔英子破涕为笑。
“哎呀好丢人。”
“你怎么上来啦？我刚刚见你不是跟季杨杨在一块嘛？”
陆泽‘咦’了一声，声调拉的很长，指着英子故意道：
“你怎么知道的？没想到伱这么关注我啊？英子啊，听哥一句劝，咱们现在开学以后已经是高三啦，心思得放在学习上。”
乔英子把脸上的泪痕全部擦去，只是眼睛还有些红肿。
她熟络的握紧小拳头，然后在陆泽的胳膊上来了轻轻一拳，轻哼道：“我那是偶然看见的好嘛？谁关注你了，别那么自恋嗷。”
女生的情绪。

来的快，去的也快。
乔英子深吸一口气，终于把心口堵着的那股子气给送了出去。
“你说，是不是追着我上来的？”
“再说，什么时候开始这么关注我的？”
“还有，我现在是高三学生，不能谈恋爱的哦！”
乔英子指着陆泽，立刻开始反击三连问。
陆泽无奈道，吐露实情：“对啊，我就是跟着你上来的，从进到班级开始的时候就注意到你了，高三不能谈恋爱没事，等我们到了大学就海阔凭鱼跃天高任鸟飞啦。”
女孩最终还是率先败下阵来。
没办法。
陆泽脸皮有亿点厚。
“不过。”
“谢谢你。”
乔英子看着身边这个高自己一头的男生，她的眼神温柔起来，忽然说了这么一句话。
content_en:
On the rooftop, the girl with the ponytail cried alone.
When Lu Ze came here, all he saw was a lonely figure.
This girl, who had been smiling so carelessly in class, seemed to be crying so sadly for the first time.
He slowly walked to his deskmate, without speaking to comfort him, but silently took out a wet tissue.
Qiao Yingzi held this tissue and suddenly started crying even harder.
"Why did she treat me like that? My dream is to become an astronaut, not to score 700 points in the college entrance examination."
"That's her dream, not mine!"
Qiao Yingzi's eyes were red and swollen from crying, and she couldn't understand why her mother couldn't respect her ideas.
Ever since she was a child, she has always followed the route her mother planned for her, and whenever the two of them had a slight disagreement, Yingzi seemed to eventually switch to her mother's route called 'for your own good'.
Lu Ze gently patted Qiao Yingzi's head.
His tone was somewhat gentle.
"Don't cry, look in the mirror now and see if you are ugly? Didn't you say you would still protect me from now on? You don't look like such a big sister like Qiao Yingzi at all."
Qiao Yingzi burst into laughter.
"Oh, it's so embarrassing."
"Why are you up here? Didn't I just see you with Ji Yangyang?"
Lu Ze said "Huh" in a long tone, pointed at Yingzi and said deliberately:
"How did you know? I didn't expect you to pay so much attention to me? Yingzi, please listen to my brother's advice. We are already in our senior year after school starts, so we have to focus on studying."
Qiao Yingzi wiped away all the tears on her face, but her eyes were still a little red and swollen.
She clenched her fists familiarly, then punched Lu Ze lightly on the arm, humming softly: "I saw it by chance, okay? Who is paying attention to you? Don't be so narcissistic."
Girls' emotions.
As quickly as it came, it went as quickly as it came.
Qiao Yingzi took a deep breath and finally let out the anger that was blocking her heart.
"Tell me, did you come after me?"
"Besides, when did you start paying so much attention to me?"
"Also, I'm a senior in high school now, so I can't fall in love!"
Qiao Yingzi pointed at Lu Ze and immediately started to counterattack with three consecutive questions.
Lu Ze said helplessly and revealed the truth: "Yes, I just followed you up here. I noticed you from the moment I entered the class. It's okay if you can't fall in love in the third year of high school. When we get to college, the sea will be vast and the fish can fly high in the sky."
The girl finally lost the battle first.
no way.
Lu Ze's face is a hundred million points thick.
"But."
"Thank you."
Qiao Yingzi looked at the boy next to her who was a head taller than her. Her eyes became gentle and she suddenly said this.
